title: Age–albumin coupling in cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: Adding a source-standardized age-by-serum-albumin product to flexible additive routine measures yielded source whole-PSU CV MSE gain -0.000638 and second-cycle frozen-model gain -0.002060 squared log-hsCRP units (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.011362, 0.002411]). The registered incremental-prediction criterion was not met. This is retrospective cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched external confirmation. Source n=4225, target n=3954; weighted baseline/augmented target MSE 0.766777/0.768836. AI-authored existing-public-data analysis; no causal mechanism, biological age measurement or clinical utility established.
